what_the_source_says: Darnold will not play in the Week 10 game against the Raiders. Lock is expected to start again, his second straight start in place of Darnold. Rookie Jalen Milroe is slated to back up Lock for the second straight week.

Jackson suffered a fractured and dislocated right thumb, had surgery and is expected to miss at least six weeks. Huntley is out for the season with turf toe. With both on injured reserve the Ravens started undrafted third-stringer Joe Fagnano, then traded for Jacoby Brissett.

Willis was placed on injured reserve and will miss Weeks 10-13. Second-year quarterback Kyle McCord will fill in, beginning with his first NFL start. Brady Cook is on the practice squad and likely to be elevated as the backup.

Quarterback Carson Beck will start Sunday's game against the Rams, per head coach Mike LaFleur - his first career start after being a third-round pick in the 2026 draft. The same roundup lists the earlier move that made Beck the starter and Jacoby Brissett third string.

Quarterback Deshaun Watson will start Sunday against the Texans. Watson cleared concussion protocol before Cleveland's Week 9 game but was inactive as Shedeur Sanders got the start in the loss to New Orleans.

Jacobs will undergo surgery and his return is to be determined. Without Jacobs and with Lloyd inactive due to a knee injury, Johnson racked up a career-high 68 yards on 14 carries. The source lists Johnson, Lloyd, Pierre Strong and Chris Brooks as the backs Green Bay turns to.
